issues.sentence: Evolutionary relationships among different Plasmodium species do not always follow taxonomic boundaries; some species that are morphologically similar or infect the same host turn out to be distantly related.
issues.fix: Soften absolute ('always/never/proven') unless an established claim backs it.

issues.sentence: Purpose Malaria continues to rank among the most significant and deadly infectious diseases, with over 282 million estimated cases and more than 610,000 deaths reported by the WHO in 2025.
issues.fix: Verify numbers ['282 million'] against sources or remove.
